tracks.title: One Waffle Each
tracks.subject: a British tourist at a Vienna hotel breakfast buffet who sets her alarm for six fifty-five every morning of the holiday to beat a German family to the only flip-over waffle iron, and on the last day finds the dad has left her the batter jug and a waffle already turning
tracks.caption: Minor-key dance-pop, mid-2020s club-leaning pop with a house pulse. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick, a rubbery plucked analog synth bassline, stabbing minor-key synth chords on the offbeat, tight open hi-hats and stacked handclaps on two and four. Glossy club mix, dry upfront vocal, short plate reverb on the claps. Female mezzo with crisp chest voice, half-spoken asides in the verses and a belted chorus. 122 BPM, A minor. Mock-dramatic, competitive and giggling at itself. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no ballad breakdown, no big-room EDM drop, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - plucked synth bass and kick, claps enter]

[Verse 1]
Six fifty-five, my alarm goes off in room four-twelve
Hair in a clip and my flip-flops on, I don't need help
There's a dad from Stuttgart with a jug in his hand
And one flip waffle iron in the whole of the land

[Pre-Chorus]
He's got long arms and a jug, I've got a plan
Pour, close, turn it, I'm faster than the man

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
The sign says please, but it's out of my reach
Batter on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, that one's for me

[Verse 2]
Tuesday he brought the twins in matching yellow coats
Wednesday I was down before they'd boiled the oats
The lady with the eggs says you two should be friends
I said Grüß Gott, it's war until the holiday ends

[Pre-Chorus]
He nods at the jam, I nod at the cream
Nobody here is eating any muesli

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
The sign says please, but it's out of my reach
Batter on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, that one's for me

[Bridge - bass and claps only]
Last day, case packed, the iron's already turning
A note on the jug says auf Wiedersehen, it's yours this morning

[Chorus]
One waffle each, one waffle each
He left me the batter and the jug in reach
Sugar on my sleeve and the timer at three
Flip it like you mean it, he made one for me

[Outro - synth stabs and claps, cut on the downbeat]

tracks.title: Coach Twelve, Seat Sixty-One
tracks.subject: two strangers stuck for four hours on a Eurostar halted in a field outside Lille split the one tin of sardines, a squashed baguette and a clementine she had packed, swap numbers on the back of a ticket, and a year later book the same train, coach and seats on purpose, bringing two tins this time
tracks.caption: Bedroom-born indie pop, 2020s alternative pop with a home-studio feel. Chorus-soaked clean electric guitar arpeggios, a round fingered bass, a dry live drum kit with brushed snare, a soft Juno synth pad and small glockenspiel accents on the chorus. Warm home-recorded feel, light tape saturation, roomy drums, intimate double-tracked vocal in the chorus. Male tenor, soft and close, lifting into head voice, conversational in the verses. 104 BPM, D major. Shy, warm and quietly giddy. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no stadium rock guitars, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chorus guitar arpeggio and glockenspiel]

[Verse 1]
Stopped in a field somewhere outside of Lille
The trolley sold out and the lights went still
You pulled out a tin with a key on the lid
And said I've only got one, so you get half of it

[Pre-Chorus]
Half a baguette that you'd sat on by mistake
One clementine, and you pushed the bigger half my way

[Chorus]
Coach twelve, seat sixty-one
Four hours late and I didn't want it done
Oil on my fingers, salt on your sleeve
Stuck on a train that I didn't want to leave

[Verse 2]
The driver said sorry in French, then again
You translated badly and I laughed like a friend
You wrote down your number on the back of my ticket
In smudgy blue biro, I folded it into my pocket

[Pre-Chorus]
And when we rolled into London at ten
You said if it's ever this slow, call me then

[Chorus]
Coach twelve, seat sixty-one
Four hours late and I didn't want it done
Oil on my fingers, salt on your sleeve
Stuck on a train that I didn't want to leave

[Bridge - pad and brushed snare]
A year to the day, we both booked the same two seats
You held up two tins and said nobody's stuck, it's a treat

[Chorus]
Coach twelve, seat sixty-one
Right on time and I still don't want it done
Oil on my fingers, salt on your sleeve
Sharing a train that I don't want to leave

[Outro - glockenspiel and guitar, fading]

tracks.title: Rocks on the Windowsill
tracks.subject: a woman whose boyfriend spends every weekend splitting shale in a disused Yorkshire quarry and fills her flat with ammonites on the windowsills, a trilobite in the butter dish and a hammer in the dishwasher, and she lists it all while not quite asking him to stop
tracks.caption: Country-tinged sardonic pop, mid-2020s pop single with a 70s twang. Twangy clean Telecaster licks answering every line, a bouncy 70s-style electric piano, a walking bass guitar, light pedal steel swells under the chorus, tight dry pop drums. Bright polished pop mix with retro 70s warmth, close sweet vocal with tight stacked harmonies on the hook. Female soprano, breezy and sweet with a sly deadpan bite. 116 BPM, G major. Exasperated, fond and eye-rolling. No trap beat, no autotune, no banjo breakdown, no stadium country drums, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Telecaster lick and electric piano]

[Verse 1]
Saturday he's gone by six in a high-vis vest
Some quarry outside Whitby where the shale is best
Comes home grey to the elbows like a sculptor's ghost
With a carrier bag of something older than toast

[Pre-Chorus]
I said where do they go, he said wherever there's room
That was February, it's June

[Chorus]
Rocks on the windowsill, rocks on the shelf
A trilobite in the butter dish by itself
He says two hundred million years, babe, isn't that sweet
I say they waited that long, they can wait out in the street

[Verse 2]
There's a hammer in the dishwasher, I didn't put it there
There's an ammonite in a sock on the back of the chair
He labels them in pencil with a date and a name
And I swear the one called Brenda's in my picture frame

[Pre-Chorus]
My mother came to visit and sat on a fern
From the Jurassic, apparently. She did not return

[Chorus]
Rocks on the windowsill, rocks on the shelf
A trilobite in the butter dish by itself
He says two hundred million years, babe, look at the curl
I say I've waited three years for a ring, not a curl

[Bridge - pedal steel and electric piano]
But he holds one up to the lamp at night
Shows me the ribs where the shell caught light

[Chorus]
Rocks on the windowsill, rocks on the shelf
I cleared him one whole drawer, didn't tell him myself
He says two hundred million years, babe, isn't that sweet
I say fine, keep the drawer, but the butter dish is mine, my sweet

[Outro - Telecaster lick, cold stop]

tracks.title: Shake That Tree, Darlene
tracks.subject: an old Texas couple bringing in their pecan harvest in November with a tree shaker borrowed from the co-op for one afternoon only, the husband clamping the trunk while his wife drives the sweeper, nuts bouncing off the truck roof, both racing the co-op man who is coming at four to take the shaker back
tracks.caption: Western swing, Texas dancehall revival in the Bob Wills line. Twin fiddles playing harmonized swing lines, a swinging lap steel guitar taking hot breaks, upright slap bass, boom-chick acoustic rhythm guitar, rolling barrelhouse piano and a brushed snare shuffle. Live-room dancehall sound, warm ribbon-mic tone, light room reverb, the whole band playing at once. Male baritone with an easy Texas drawl, band members hollering between lines. 168 BPM, C major. Rowdy, sunny and teasing. No modern pop drums, no autotune, no trap, no rock electric guitar, no stadium country production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twin fiddles and steel kick off, band holler]

[Verse 1]
The co-op gave us one afternoon
One big yellow shaker and a man named June
Said I'll be back at four o'clock sharp
Don't you go shaking my good sense apart

[Pre-Chorus]
I clamp the trunk and I give her the nod
Darlene's on the sweeper hollering at God

[Chorus]
Shake that tree, Darlene
The pecans are coming down on the roof of the old machine
They're bouncing off the truck and the dog and me
Shake that tree, Darlene, shake that tree

[Verse 2]
Forty-one trees that my daddy put in
Half of them crooked and the rest too thin
The sweeper's choking on a bushel of leaves
She's kicking it and cussing with her rolled-up sleeves

[Pre-Chorus]
It's a quarter to three and we're on tree nine
She says honey, are you counting or wasting time

[Chorus]

tracks.title: Ride-On Through Bolton
tracks.subject: a council grounds worker in Bolton who mows the roundabouts and grass verges on a ride-on mower every summer, waves at the same bus driver at the same roundabout each morning, and spares one patch of wild orchids on the ring road verge that she tapes off with her own bunting
tracks.caption: Northern soul, mid-60s Detroit-style stomper as played at UK allnighters. Stomping four-on-the-floor drums with tambourine on every beat, bright brass section stabs, a driving melodic electric bass, chiming vibraphone and choppy rhythm guitar. Compressed mid-60s mix, warm tape hiss, room reverb on the brass. Female soul vocal with a strong gritty chest voice, backing singers answering in call and response. 112 BPM, E-flat major. Driving, proud and high-spirited. No modern pop drums, no autotune, no synths, no hip-hop beat, no slow ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tambourine and stomp, brass stab, vibraphone]

[Verse 1]
Seven a.m. at the Beehive roundabout
Ear defenders on and the choke pulled out
The 501 goes by with Terry at the wheel
He gives two toots and I wave from behind the wheel

[Pre-Chorus]
Cut the grass, cut the grass (cut it low)
Round and round, there I go

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Stripes on the verges like a wedding flower
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Verse 2]
Out on the ring road near the Asda sign
There's purple orchids growing in a crooked line
I stopped my engine and I counted nine
Then I taped off the patch with bunting of mine

[Pre-Chorus]
Go round it, go round it (don't you dare)
The council knows I put it there

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Stripes on the verges round an orchid flower
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Bridge - drums and handclaps, brass build]
Terry slowed the bus down just to see
Nine little orchids and the bunting and me

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Terry's got his passengers waving at the flowers
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Outro - brass and tambourine vamp, fade]

tracks.title: Lewat Harmoni
tracks.subject: a Jakarta commuter on TransJakarta who teaches the woman standing beside him how to transfer at Harmoni from the Blok M line to the Kalideres line, every morning for two weeks, until one day they both stay on the bus past Harmoni on purpose
tracks.caption: Indonesian Gen-Z romantic pop duet, laid-back mid-tempo groove. Bright nylon-string acoustic guitar strumming syncopated chords, muted funk electric guitar picking sixteenths, warm Rhodes pads, round finger-played electric bass, light live drums with a soft shaker. Clean, airy, close-miked production with small-room warmth. Male light tenor and female soft alto trading lines conversationally, joining in unison on the chorus. 98 BPM, D major. Giddy, shy and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no dangdut kendang, no orchestral swells.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and Rhodes, shaker enters]

[Verse 1 - Male]
Halte Blok M, jam tujuh kurang lima
Kamu pegang peta, kebalik pula
Mau ke Kalideres, katamu ragu
Turun di Harmoni, ikut aku

[Verse 2 - Female]
Jembatannya panjang, tangganya licin
Kamu jalan duluan, nengok ke belakang
Besoknya aku pura-pura lupa lagi
Kamu jelasin lagi, sabar banget

[Pre-Chorus - Duet]
Udah dua minggu, kamu masih nanya
Aku tahu, aku tahu, kamu hafal juga

[Chorus - Duet]
Turun di Harmoni, pindah koridor
Naik jembatan, belok kiri, jangan salah antre
Kamu hafal jalannya, aku hafal suaramu
Besok pagi, ajarin aku lagi

[Verse 3 - Male]
Senin pagi, pintu kebuka di Harmoni
Kamu nggak berdiri, aku juga diam
Pintunya nutup, kita sampai Kota
Sama-sama telat, sama-sama ketawa

[Chorus - Duet]
Lewat Harmoni, nggak pindah koridor
Biar telat, biar kena tegur bos
Kamu hafal jalannya, aku hafal suaramu
Besok pagi, kita lewat lagi

[Outro - nylon guitar alone, Rhodes fades]

tracks.title: Pesanan Kopi Lantai Tujuh
tracks.subject: a first-job intern on the seventh floor of a Jakarta office whose only task for three weeks is photocopying, until his supervisor finally trusts him to take and place the whole office's afternoon coffee order
tracks.caption: Malang twinkle midwest emo with math-rock guitar work. Two clean, bright electric guitars tapping interlocking arpeggios in odd phrasing, a melodic picked bass moving under them, a busy and tight drum kit with snare rolls and open hats, a short muted trumpet line in the bridge. Dry live-room recording with slight tape hiss and no polish. Earnest male mid-range vocal that cracks into strained shouts on the chorus, gang vocals on the last chorus. 152 BPM, E major. Jittery, self-mocking and quietly proud. No pop-punk power chords chugging, no screamo, no autotune, no synths, no stadium reverb.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twinkly tapped guitars, drums crash in]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pertama aku fotokopi
Minggu kedua aku fotokopi
Mesinnya macet, aku yang dimarahi
Kertasnya hangat, cuma dia temanku

[Pre-Chorus]
Mbak Sari bilang sabar itu proses
Aku bilang toner juga

[Chorus]
Tekan lagi, tekan lagi
Seratus lembar, bolak-balik, rangkap tiga
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Nggak ada yang tahu namaku

[Verse 2]
Jumat sore, jam tiga lewat
Mbak Sari panggil, kasih aku ponsel
Kamu yang pesan kopi buat semua
Aku tulis nama kayak tanda tangan kontrak

[Pre-Chorus]
Pak Budi less sugar, Mbak Sari oat
Satu lagi buat aku, boleh, katanya

[Chorus]
Tulis lagi, tulis lagi
Dua belas gelas, nggak ada yang salah
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Hari ini semua tahu namaku

[Bridge - bass and trumpet, half-time]
Nggak ada yang tepuk tangan
Cuma Pak Budi bilang, pas manisnya

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Tekan lagi, tekan lagi
Senin pagi aku fotokopi lagi
Tiga minggu aku di pojok sini
Tapi kopi hari ini aku yang pesan

[Outro - guitars tapping alone, ends on one chord]

tracks.title: Kelas Memanjat
tracks.subject: a keeper at an orangutan rehabilitation centre in East Kalimantan who spends every morning of forest school coaxing one orphaned young orangutan off her back and onto a liana, counting the metres it climbs before it slides down to her again
tracks.caption: Dayak sape' folk-pop from East Kalimantan. Dayak sape' lute playing interlocking repeated motifs over a drone, soft long hand drum in a walking pattern, upright acoustic bass, breathy bamboo flute answering the voice, light hanging gong accents at phrase ends. Spacious natural reverb like an open wooden longhouse, unhurried. Warm female low-middle register with a plain, unornamented delivery and soft hummed backing. 84 BPM, A minor. Patient, tender and a little worried. No EDM, no trap, no pop drum kit, no autotune, no cinematic strings.

tracks.title: Beo Pian
tracks.subject: a Banjarmasin man whose talking myna was meant to learn a pantun for the bird show, but only ever learned his wife's voice calling him home from the riverside coffee stall, and now shouts it at him in front of his friends
tracks.caption: Banjar panting pop from South Kalimantan with a japin dance lilt. Panting lute strummed fast and bright, babun frame drum in a skipping japin rhythm, low gong on the downbeat, a sawing violin melody doubling the hook, acoustic bass. Lively, slightly raw front-porch acoustic band sound. Bright nasal male tenor with comic spoken asides, a female voice squawking the bird's lines. 128 BPM, G major. Bouncy, cheeky and laughing. No dangdut koplo, no EDM, no trap, no autotune, no rock drum kit.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - panting strum, babun skips in, violin hook]

[Verse 1]
Aku beli beo di Pasar Sudimampir
Niatnya biar dia pintar berpantun
Tiap pagi aku ajari satu bait
Dia cuma miring, terus menguap

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga bulan sabar, tiga bulan sepi
Sampai Selasa sore dia bersuara

[Chorus]
Bang, pulang Bang, nasinya dingin
Persis suara istriku di pintu
Teman di warung ketawa semua
Kopiku belum habis, Bang, pulang Bang

[Verse 2]
Aku bawa ke lomba di Siring
Juri duduk, mikrofon dinyalakan
Aku bisikkan bait yang sudah kuhafal
Dia tarik napas panjang

[Pre-Chorus]
Semua orang diam, aku berdoa
Beo itu menatap aku saja

[Chorus]
Bang, pulang Bang, nasinya dingin
Satu lapangan dengar suara istriku
Juri ketawa sampai menangis
Pialanya nggak dapat, Bang, pulang Bang

[Bridge - violin and babun, spoken]
Istriku bilang beo itu pintar
Yang bodoh yang nongkrong sampai magrib

[Outro - panting strum, one last squawk, gong]

tracks.title: Huruf Nenek
tracks.subject: a young man in Makassar learning the Bugis lontara script letter by letter from a primary-school workbook so he can read the folded letters his grandmother sent him while he worked in a Malaysian palm-oil plantation, which he kept for six years without ever reading
tracks.caption: Bugis-Makassar kecapi ballad from South Sulawesi. Boat-shaped two-string kecapi plucked in rippling repeated figures, a reedy single-stringed keso-keso fiddle shadowing the melody, gendang bugis hand drum played softly with fingers, warm acoustic bass. Intimate, wooden room sound with a little air. Gentle male baritone, close and conversational. 76 BPM, D minor. Slow-dawning, warm and quietly amused. No pop drum kit, no synth pads, no autotune, no trap, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kecapi ripple, keso-keso enters]

[Verse 1]
Enam tahun di kebun sawit Sabah
Tiap bulan ada surat dari Bone
Hurufnya kayak gelombang kecil
Aku lipat, aku simpan, nggak kubaca

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku malu bilang nggak bisa
Nenek kira cucunya pintar

[Chorus]
Ka, ga, nga, aku eja pelan-pelan
Buku tulis anak kelas tiga
Surat pertama baru dua baris
Nenek tanya, sudah makan atau belum

[Verse 2]
Malam ini aku sampai surat kelima
Dia cerita ayam yang hilang
Dia cerita tetangga yang curang
Dia tulis, jangan kirim uang dulu

[Pre-Chorus]
Enam tahun dia ngobrol sendiri
Aku yang datang terlambat

[Chorus]
Ka, ga, nga, aku eja pelan-pelan
Tujuh puluh dua surat di kardus mi
Surat kelima akhirnya habis
Nenek tanya, kapan pulang ke Bone

[Bridge - kecapi alone]
Besok aku tulis balasan pertama
Hurufku miring, pasti dia ketawa

[Outro - kecapi and keso-keso, fading]

tracks.title: トング係
tracks.mood: flustered, eager and finally triumphant, a workplace comedy you can dance to
tracks.subject: a new hire at her first welcome party (歓迎会) at a yakiniku restaurant, handed the tongs by her section chief and put in charge of grilling for the whole table of eight, juggling who wants their meat rare, the burning tare and the chief's order of tongue first
tracks.caption: Japanese nu-disco dance-pop, mid-2020s disco revival in the vein of J-pop meets UK dance producers. Octave-jumping slap bass, choppy clean funk rhythm guitar, filtered string stabs that open up on the chorus, four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats and stacked handclaps. Glossy, wide mix with punchy compressed kick and dry upfront vocal. Bright female mid-high vocal, a little flustered, lifting into falsetto on the chorus, male backing vocals answering. 120 BPM, A minor. Flustered, eager and finally triumphant workplace comedy. No trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rock guitars, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass, filtered strings, four-on-the-floor kick]

[Verse 1]
入社して五日目 私の歓迎会
座敷の八人 網がふたつ
乾杯のあとで 課長が言った
「主役が焼くのが うちの伝統」

[Pre-Chorus]
トング渡され 手が震える
タンからだよね 塩からだよね

[Chorus]
焼いて 焼いて 返して 返して
部長はレアで 先輩はよく焼き
新人なのに トング係
煙の中で 踊ってる

[Verse 2]
カルビの脂で 炎が上がる
氷ひとつ 置けばいいって 隣の人
ハラミが網に くっついて
「それ俺の」って 三人が言う

[Pre-Chorus]
自分の皿は まだ真っ白
でもなんだか 笑えてくる

[Chorus]
焼いて 焼いて 返して 返して
部長はレアで 課長は塩だけ
新人なのに トング係
みんなの顔が 見えてくる

[Bridge - bass and handclaps only]
最後のロース 自分の皿に
課長が黙って 置いてくれた

[Chorus]
焼けた 焼けた 全部焼けた
部長も課長も 「うまい」って言った
来年もやるよ トング係
髪まで焼肉の においでも

tracks.title: こたつで千ピース
tracks.mood: hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud, a grandpa's personal-best comedy
tracks.subject: a retired salaryman alone at the kotatsu over one winter weekend, timing himself on a stopwatch to finish the 1000-piece Mount Fuji jigsaw his grandson did in nine hours at New Year, sorting edge pieces into a biscuit tin and losing an hour to a sky made of nothing but blue
tracks.caption: Japanese hyperpop, 2020s Tokyo netlabel lineage with experimental electronic edges. Detuned supersaw stabs, blown-out distorted 808 kick and sub bass, glitch-stuttered synth arpeggio, bitcrushed snare rolls that stop dead before each chorus. Maximal, clipped and glitchy production with sudden drop-outs to near silence. Male mid-range vocal, fast clipped deadpan delivery that breaks into a shouted chorus, natural doubling only. 160 BPM, F# minor. Hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud. No autotune, no trap flow, no ballad piano, no guitar band, no EDM festival build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - glitchy detuned synth stabs, distorted 808 kick]

[Verse 1]
正月に孫が 九時間で仕上げた
千ピースの富士山 箱ごと置いてった
土曜の朝 こたつに広げて
ストップウォッチ 押してみる

[Pre-Chorus]
まず端っこ 端っこだけ
煎餅の缶に 選り分けて

[Chorus]
千ピース 千ピース
空が全部 同じ青
ばあさん言う 「まだやってるの」
やってるよ 千ピース

[Verse 2]
老眼鏡 二本かけ替える
雪のとこは 白しかない
一時間かけて はまったのが一個
声出して 喜んだ

[Bridge - synths drop out, kick only]
日曜の夜 残り三つ
こたつ布団 めくったら
落ちてた ひとつ

[Chorus]
千ピース 千ピース
十一時間 孫に負けた
ばあさん言う 「でも綺麗ね」
写真撮って 孫に送る

[Outro - glitch stutters, synths collapse to silence]

tracks.title: ハウスの朝
tracks.subject: a young couple who grow strawberries in Moka, Tochigi, picking tochiaika in the greenhouse at 5:30 on January mornings; he packs the boxes so she can pick at her own pace, and they split a can of hot oshiruko on the way back from the farm stand
tracks.caption: Japanese Afrobeats pop, mid-tempo Afrobeats groove sung in Japanese. Clean palm-muted highlife guitar riff, round warm bass, shakers and congas in a syncopated pattern, talking drum fills between lines, soft Rhodes chords. Sunny, spacious mix with a soft low end and an intimate dry vocal. Male baritone-tenor, relaxed and close, gentle melodic delivery, light female harmony on the final chorus. 104 BPM, D major. Warm, unhurried and in love. No amapiano log drum, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no reggae skank, no EDM synths.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted highlife guitar, shakers, talking drum]

[Verse 1]
一月の真岡 朝五時半
ビニールハウスの中だけ 春みたい
君はしゃがんで とちあいかを摘む
指先ばっかり 赤くして

[Pre-Chorus]
曇ったメガネを 袖で拭いて
君がこっちを 見て笑う

[Chorus]
ゆっくりでいいよ 隣にいるから
パック詰めは 僕がやるから
ハウスの中は 二十度で
君がいるから ちょうどいい

[Verse 2]
昼は軽トラで 直売所まで
帰りに買うのは 缶のおしるこ
君は半分 僕にくれて
残りの半分 両手で持つ

[Pre-Chorus]
来年の苗の 話をしながら
ハウスの扉 二人で閉める

[Chorus - with female harmony]
ゆっくりでいいよ 隣にいるから
明日の朝も 五時半だから
外は氷点下 でも平気
君がいるから ちょうどいい

[Outro - guitar riff and talking drum, fade]

tracks.title: 開かねえ
tracks.subject: a young man in Asahikawa at six in the morning at minus twenty-five whose car door handle and lock are frozen solid before work, scraping ice with a point card and warming the key with a lighter, until he gets in through the passenger door
tracks.caption: Japanese drift phonk, Memphis-rooted phonk with the drift-style cowbell lead. Distorted cowbell melody up front, heavy saturated 808 bass, Memphis-style drum machine with rattling hi-hats, dark detuned bell pad underneath. Dark, saturated lo-fi mix with tape hiss. Male low-register vocal, gritty half-rapped chant, close and dry, gang-shout on the chorus. 130 BPM, C# minor. Frozen, furious and finally laughing. No autotune, no melodic pop chorus, no EDM build, no rock guitars, no trap melodies.

[Intro - distorted cowbell melody, 808 drop]

朝六時 旭川 マイナス二十五

tracks.title: 挟まれたもみじ
tracks.subject: a ward library staffer in November who keeps finding a pressed maple leaf inside different returned books each week, is not allowed to check the borrowing records to find out who, and one morning tucks a ginkgo leaf into the book as a reply
tracks.caption: Japanese 70s-style piano soft-rock pop, the retro piano-led singer-songwriter sound revived by current J-pop stars. Warm upright piano with rolling chords, soft Wurlitzer fills, round fingered bass, brushed drums, a light warm string section on the last chorus. Warm analog 1970s-style studio sound, roomy piano, tape warmth. Female alto, soft and conversational, close-miked, a slight smile in the delivery. 84 BPM, E-flat major. Quiet, curious and gently amused. No EDM, no trap beat, no autotune, no power ballad belting, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo upright piano, rolling chords]

[Verse 1]
返却ポストを 開けるのは 朝九時
十一月の 区立図書館
返ってきた 詩集のあいだに
押し葉のもみじ 一枚

[Pre-Chorus]
落とし物の 箱に入れるか
迷って ページを閉じた

[Chorus]
誰ですか 先週も 挟んだのは
旅行記にも 料理の本にも
私は棚に 戻すだけ
ひとつも抜かずに 戻すだけ

[Verse 2]
カウンター越しに 顔を見ても
みんな同じ 冬の手袋
貸出記録は 見ちゃいけない
それが仕事の 決まりだから

[Pre-Chorus]
だから今朝は イチョウを一枚
返事のつもりで 挟んでおいた

[Chorus - strings enter]
誰ですか 気づいたら 笑ってください
黄色いのは 私からです
次の木曜 返ってきた本に
もみじがふたつ 入ってた

[Outro - piano alone, ritardando]

tracks.title: 곗돈 장부
tracks.subject: the narrator keeps the shared money book and the cash envelope for four school friends saving 50,000 won each a month for their first trip abroad together (Fukuoka), while one friend, Minjae, keeps 'borrowing' from it, until the narrator opens the envelope and finds Minjae has paid it all back with interest and a note saying to go get passport photos
tracks.caption: Jazz-drum soft indie rock, Korean indie band sound of the mid-2020s. Clean electric guitar with a light chorus shimmer playing lazy seventh chords, a brushed jazz drum kit with swung ghost notes on the snare, round fingered electric bass walking under the changes, soft Rhodes pads in the gaps. Warm tape-saturated lo-fi room sound with gentle reverb and an unhurried live-band feel. Male tenor, soft and breathy, close-mic, with light falsetto lifts on the chorus. 86 BPM, D major. Rueful, warm and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no EDM build, no autotune, no stadium drums, no big pop ballad strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chorus guitar and brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
고등학교 때부터 넷이 모은 돈
매달 오만 원씩, 후쿠오카 가자고
장부는 내가 쓰고 봉투도 내가 들고
책상 서랍 맨 밑 칸, 고무줄 두 번 감아

[Pre-Chorus]
근데 민재가 또 전화를 했어
딱 이번 달만, 다음 달에 꼭 넣을게

[Chorus]
곗돈 장부 마지막 줄에
민재 이름 옆에 빨간 글씨
빌려 간 돈 십이만 원
비행기는 언제 타냐, 우리

[Verse 2]
삼월엔 월세, 칠월엔 축의금
갚을 땐 꼭 붕어빵 한 봉지랑 같이 와
다른 둘은 웃으면서 그냥 넘어가
나만 계산기 두드리는 사람 같아

[Pre-Chorus]
그러다 오늘 봉투를 열었는데
내가 넣은 적 없는 돈이 들어 있어

[Bridge - Rhodes and bass only]
쪽지 한 장, 삐뚤빼뚤 민재 글씨
이자까지 넣었다, 여권 사진 찍으러 가자

[Chorus]
곗돈 장부 마지막 줄에
빨간 글씨 위로 줄을 긋고
남은 돈 백팔십만 원
비행기 표 끊자, 우리 넷이

[Outro - brushed drums fade, falsetto hum]

tracks.subject: a girl who drops every 500-won coin into a narrow-necked drink bottle from January on to buy her best friend a birthday present, then finds the coins won't come back out through the neck, fishes for three hours with chopsticks and a hairpin, and ends up tying a ribbon on the whole bottle
tracks.caption: Bubblegum pop idol song in the 2025 K-pop girl-group style. Bright staccato synth plucks bouncing in octaves, a toy glockenspiel doubling the hook melody, bouncy slap bass, layered handclaps on the backbeat, a crisp four-on-the-floor kick. Glossy candy-bright mix with wide stereo claps and dry upfront vocals. Young female group vocals in a sweet high register, a chanted call-and-response chorus with group shouts. 124 BPM, A major. Bouncy, giddy and flustered. No trap beat, no rap verse, no dubstep drop, no dark minor-key synths, no autotune warble.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - synth plucks and glockenspiel, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
일월부터 모은 오백 원
편의점 잔돈 하나도 안 썼어
음료수 병에 땡그랑 땡
네 생일에 깜짝 놀래 줄 거야

[Pre-Chorus]
흔들면 찰랑, 무거워 무거워
근데 이거 어떻게 꺼내?

[Chorus]
땡그랑 땡 오백 원
병 주둥이가 너무 좁아
거꾸로 들고 흔들어 봐도
한 개도 안 나와, 어떡해

[Verse 2]
젓가락으로 하나씩 낚시
머리핀까지 넣어 봤는데
세 시간에 겨우 아홉 개
네 생일은 바로 내일인데

[Pre-Chorus]
깰까 말까, 망설이다가
그냥 병째로 리본을 묶었어

[Chorus]
땡그랑 땡 오백 원
병째로 선물 받아 줘
꺼내는 건 같이 하자
네 생일 내내, 둘이서

[Outro - group chant, claps, glockenspiel button]

tracks.title: 그늘막 점프
tracks.mood: sweaty, cheeky, dancing through the heat
tracks.subject: a man in Daegu during a 38-degree August heatwave who walks to a first date by hopping from one shade parasol at the crosswalks to the next, timing each dash to the walk signal, and arrives with his shirt soaked anyway
tracks.caption: French house idol pop, mid-2020s K-pop take on late-90s Paris filter house. A chopped disco piano loop under a sweeping low-pass filter, four-on-the-floor kick with gentle sidechain pump, slap-funk bass guitar, short pizzicato string stabs, a bright clavinet. Warm compressed groove, filter sweeps opening into the chorus, bright summery top end. Male idol vocal in a relaxed mid-range with a light falsetto lift on the hook, airy group backing. 120 BPM, A major. Sweaty, cheeky and sweet, grinning through the heat on the way to her. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hat rolls, no rap verse, no big-room synth leads, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - filtered piano loop and four-on-the-floor kick]

[Verse 1]
대구 팔월 오후 두 시 반
폰에 뜬 건 삼십팔 도
약속은 길 건너 카페
걸어서 십 분, 근데 지옥

[Pre-Chorus]
저 앞에 초록 파라솔 하나
신호 바뀌기 전에 저기까지

그늘막 점프, 하나 둘
그늘막 점프, 숨 좀 돌려

초록불엔 다음 그늘로

[Verse 2]
세 번째 그늘엔 할머니 둘
부채질하며 자리를 내 주셔

셔츠가 벌써 다 말해 줘

마지막 횡단보도 건너편

그늘막 점프, 하나 둘
그늘막 점프, 너한테로
땀범벅이어도 웃어 줘
너 보러 오는 길이었으니까

[Outro - piano loop filters down, kick fades]

tracks.subject: a young delivery rider who relies every evening on the floor numbers painted on the landings of an old walk-up apartment block, and the block's elderly caretaker (경비 아저씨) who repaints the faded numbers one landing per evening with a tape measure, finishing the seventh floor on the evening of the first snow
tracks.caption: Korean tong-guitar acoustic folk revival, 1970s Seoul coffee-house folk played by a 2020s singer-songwriter. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar with a walking bass line, a second acoustic strumming softly, harmonica answering between lines, upright bass, brushed snare. Dry live-room recording, warm tape tone, little reverb. Young male tenor, plain and conversational, close-miked. 84 BPM, G major. Warm, quiet and grateful. No ballad belting, no string swell, no electronic drums, no pop production gloss, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic guitar and harmonica]

[Verse 1]
저녁 여섯 시, 오토바이 세우고
불 꺼진 계단을 뛰어 올라가
닳아 버린 숫자 앞에서
몇 층인지 늘 헷갈렸지

[Pre-Chorus]
그런데 어제부터 이 층이
새하얗게 다시 보여

[Chorus]
경비 아저씨, 하루에 한 층
줄자 대고 붓으로 칠해
식기 전에 문 두드리라고
숫자 하나 또렷해지네

[Verse 2]
사 층 앞에 쭈그려 앉아
여기 사는 사람들은 눈 감고도 올라가지
배달 오는 총각 보라고
일부러 크게 그린다 하셨어

[Pre-Chorus]
붓 씻은 통에 김이 오르고
아저씨 손등이 빨개

[Chorus]
경비 아저씨, 하루에 한 층
오 층, 육 층, 천천히 올라
내 헬멧 위에 첫눈 오던 밤
칠 층까지 다 칠하셨네

[Outro - harmonica and guitar, softly ending]

tracks.title: Mesin Ais Lalu
tracks.subject: the driver of the ice resurfacing machine at a shopping-mall ice rink in Kuala Lumpur who clears the skaters off every two hours and crawls the machine round the rink at walking pace while forty teenagers wait at the gate
tracks.caption: Industrial hard techno, mid-2020s Kuala Lumpur warehouse style, with Malay vocals. A distorted rumble kick on every beat with a long saturated tail; metallic clang percussion like a spanner on steel; an overdriven acid 303 line squelching between two notes; white-noise risers before each drop; a crowd of voices shouting the answer lines. Dark warehouse mix, saturated low end, dry close vocal sitting on top. Male baritone, deadpan half-spoken announcer delivery that breaks into a shouted chant on the hook. 148 BPM, F minor. Deadpan, bossy and secretly proud. No pop chorus, no hardstyle reverse bass, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build-and-drop festival vocal.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rumble kick and clanging metal, acid line creeping in]

[Verse 1]
Pukul empat, loceng berbunyi
Semua keluar, jangan buat tak tahu
Budak baju merah, kasut sewa
Aku nampak kau pusing lagi satu

[Pre-Chorus]
Pintu pagar kanan, beratur tepi
Lampu kuning, enjin hidup

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Lapan kilometer sejam, jangan tolak aku
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Ais licin macam cermin, tunggu sampai aku lalu

[Verse 2]
Empat puluh orang tunggu kat pintu
Ada yang rakam, ada yang mengeluh
Satu pusingan, dua pusingan
Air panas berasap belakang aku

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan ketuk kaca, jangan jerit nama aku
Aku tak boleh laju, ni kerja halus

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Lapan kilometer sejam, sabar sikit kau
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Bila aku keluar nanti, baru ais kau punya

[Bridge - kick drops out, acid line alone, then everything slams back]
Budak baju merah lambai kat aku
Aku angkat tangan sikit je

[Chorus]
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais lalu
Pagar dah buka, pergilah kau
Mesin ais lalu, mesin ais dah lalu
Ais licin macam cermin, jangan kau jatuh dulu

[Outro - acid line and clang percussion, kick cuts dead]

tracks.title: Bajet Atas Tisu
tracks.genre: bright piano-soul pop with brass (Tulus lane)
tracks.subject: a young man on his first payslip who sits at a kopitiam and budgets every ringgit on a paper napkin so he can take his girlfriend to the Italian restaurant in Bangsar she always pointed at through the glass
tracks.caption: Bright piano-soul pop in the 2020s Indonesian-Malay singer-songwriter lane, jazz chords over a light swing feel. A bouncy acoustic piano playing syncopated major-seventh chords; warm round electric bass walking under the chorus; a light brushed drum kit with rimshots on the backbeat; a muted trumpet and flugelhorn answering the vocal; finger snaps in the verses. Clean live-room recording, close piano, natural short reverb, gentle dynamics. Male light baritone, conversational and warm, smiling delivery with a soft head-voice lift on the hook. 112 BPM, E-flat major. Cheerful, shy and proud. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no power-ballad build, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano vamp with finger snaps, a muted trumpet phrase]

[Verse 1]
Gaji pertama masuk pagi Jumaat
Aku tengok skrin tiga kali, betul ke ni
Duduk kopitiam, teh ais satu
Pen pinjam dari tauke kat kaunter

[Pre-Chorus]
Tisu ni nipis, tulisan aku tembus
Tapi kira-kira aku tebal

[Chorus]
Sewa bilik, minyak, duit mak tolak dulu
Baki ni semua aku simpan untuk kau
Restoran Bangsar yang kau tunjuk tiap kali lalu
Malam Sabtu ni, kita masuk, bukan tengok dari luar

[Verse 2]
Kau selalu cakap, "Mahal sangat tu"
Tarik tangan aku ke gerai sebelah
Aku dah semak menu kat internet
Pasta dua, air dua, dessert kita kongsi

[Pre-Chorus]
Tisu ni dah renyuk dalam dompet
Tiap malam aku buka, kira semula

[Chorus]
Sewa bilik, minyak, duit mak tolak dulu
Baki ni semua aku simpan untuk kau
Kalau tak cukup, aku makan roti seminggu
Asalkan malam tu kau tak tengok harga dulu

[Bridge - piano and bass alone, then trumpet comes back]
Pelayan bawa bil, kau nak keluarkan purse
Aku tolak perlahan, "Hari ni giliran aku"

[Chorus]
Sewa bilik, minyak, semua dah settle
Tisu tu aku lipat, aku selit dalam diari
Kau senyum depan lilin, sos tomato kat pipi
Gaji pertama aku, habis atas meja ni

[Outro - flugelhorn over piano, snaps fade]

tracks.title: Tali Lanyard Pejabat
tracks.subject: a young man alone in his newly rented room in Shah Alam whose curtain rod falls down every night with a crash; on the third night he gives up on the screws, ties the curtain back with his office lanyard and sleeps facing the orange streetlight outside the window
tracks.caption: Malay orchestral indie-rock ballad in the 2020s film-soundtrack lane. Clean electric guitar arpeggios washed in reverb; a warm upright piano carrying the chords; a string section that stays low in the verses and swells in the chorus; slow tom-heavy drums entering at the first chorus; a sustained French horn line under the bridge. Cinematic but intimate mix, strings wide, vocal close, a slow build across the whole song. Male tenor, soft and close in the verses, opening to a full chest voice in the chorus. 72 BPM, D major. Tender, gently comic and lonely. No trap, no EDM, no autotune, no rock-kapak guitar solo, no gospel choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano and reverb guitar, strings low]

[Verse 1]
Bilik sewa, tingkap satu, langsir biru pudar
Batang besi tersangkut atas dua paku
Pukul dua pagi, bunyi macam pinggan jatuh
Aku bangun, langsir dah terlipat atas lantai

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam pertama, aku pasang semula
Ketuk paku guna tumit kasut

[Chorus]
Langsir jatuh lagi, tak ada siapa dengar
Cuma aku, cuma bunyi besi berguling
Bilik ni senyap, dinding pun belum kenal nama aku
Aku sangkut balik, aku tutup mata

[Verse 2]
Malam kedua, aku pinjam skru dari kedai bawah
Pakcik tu tanya, baru pindah ke, aku angguk saja
Aku pusing skru guna duit syiling
Pukul tiga, besi tu jatuh lagi, tepat atas kaki

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku ketawa sorang dalam gelap
Siapa nak percaya, langsir pun tak nak duduk sini

[Chorus]
Langsir jatuh lagi, tak ada siapa dengar
Cuma aku, cuma bunyi besi berguling
Bilik ni senyap, telefon pun tak berbunyi
Aku sangkut balik, aku kira sampai seratus

[Bridge - French horn and strings, drums drop out]
Malam ketiga aku tak cari paku
Aku tanggal tali lanyard pejabat, ikat langsir ke tepi

[Chorus]
Langsir tak jatuh lagi, tingkap terbuka separuh
Lampu jalan oren masuk sampai ke bantal
Kad nama aku tergantung tepi tingkap
Aku tidur menghadap cahaya tu, malam ni cukuplah

[Outro - piano and guitar, strings fall away]

tracks.title: Sesenti, Seratus Tahun
tracks.subject: a cave guide at Gua Tempurung in Perak leading a noisy school group through the limestone chambers, telling them over and over not to touch the stalactites because the oil on their hands stops the stone growing and one centimetre takes about a hundred years
tracks.caption: Malay big-band swing, brassy dance-hall style revived by 2020s Malaysian swing and big-band acts. A full brass section of trumpets, trombones and saxophones playing tight riffs and a shout chorus; a walking upright bass; swing ride cymbal with snare fills kicking the brass hits; a stride piano comping between phrases; a clarinet obbligato weaving round the vocal. Live-room big-band recording, natural room reverb, vintage ribbon-mic warmth. Male baritone crooner with quick tour-guide patter, sly and theatrical, band members shouting the answer lines. 168 BPM, B-flat major. Cheeky, brisk and theatrical. No electro-swing beats, no EDM, no trap, no autotune, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - brass fanfare, walking bass, ride cymbal]

[Verse 1]
Selamat datang ke Gua Tempurung
Topi keledar, lampu, ikat tali kasut
Yang depan sekali, budak cermin mata
Jangan lari, lantai licin, nanti jatuh bergolek

[Pre-Chorus]
Nampak batu tergantung dari siling?
Berapa lama dia nak panjang? Teka!

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Setitik air, satu hari, satu cerita
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, cikgu pun sama

[Verse 2]
Bilik pertama, bilik kedua
Air menitik atas kepala cikgu
Budak belakang kira guna jari
Sepuluh senti? Seribu tahun! Dia terdiam dulu

[Pre-Chorus]
Batu ni mula tumbuh sebelum moyang kau lahir
Satu sentuhan, minyak tangan, dia berhenti

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Selfie boleh, sentuh tak boleh, sabar sikit saja
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, cikgu pun sama

[Bridge - brass shout chorus, then stops dead]
Matikan lampu, semua diam
Dengar air menitik, satu, dua

[Chorus]
Sesenti, seratus tahun!
Cucu kau datang, baru dia tambah sesenti
Dia tengok batu yang kau tak sentuh
Sesenti, seratus tahun, tangan dalam poket, macam kau sekarang

[Outro - full band hit, clarinet trill, final brass stab]

tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien UK garage, late-90s London 2-step style. 電鈴歹去 規間學校恬恬
校長講 修理愛等禮拜五
工友阿伯 去倉庫內底揣
揣出一粒銅鈴 生鉎黃黃

[Pre-Chorus]
七點五十 伊徛佇走廊尾
深深吸一口氣 手攑懸懸

[Chorus]
叮噹 叮噹 第一節開始
阿伯搖鈴 搖甲規條走廊
叮噹 叮噹 囡仔走入去教室
這禮拜 時間攏佇伊手內

第三節 伊去便所 慢一分鐘
數學老師 加教一條算式
規班的囡仔 目睭金金看窗外
等阿伯的鈴聲 來救規班

十二點 便當的味 飄過來
伊家己嘛 偷偷提早三分

叮噹 叮噹 食晝時間到

伊共銅鈴 提起來看一下

叮噹 叮噹 放學的時間
阿伯搖鈴 搖上尾一擺

tracks.mood: sunny, brassy and giddy, a bargain that dances off across the kitchen
tracks.subject: an auntie who haggles across three towns' secondhand shops for one used washing machine, gets it home for 3,500 with a free hose, and on its first spin cycle it walks across the kitchen while her husband, son and daughter chase it, until the daughter sits on it and her husband wedges a wood chip under its short leg
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Ghanaian highlife in the classic guitar-band style. tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
舊貨仔店 我行過三个庄
頭一間喊八千 我越頭就走
第二間五千 門蓋仔關袂密
第三間的頭家 予我講甲頭殼疼

[Pre-Chorus]
三千五 閣送一條水管
我叫阮翁 去借鐵牛仔來載

[Chorus]
洗衫機 洗衫機 載轉來囉
三千五 規庄上俗的寶
洗衫機 洗衫機 好物無貴
規家伙仔 攏出來共你迎

[Verse]
扛入灶跤 插電 衫褲囥落去
囡仔圍咧看 親像咧看電影
水放滇 伊踅甲真好聽
脫水一開 伊煞跳起來

[Pre-Chorus]
喀喀喀 愈搖愈大力
對灶跤 一步一步行出去

[Chorus]
洗衫機 洗衫機 你欲去佗
阮翁攬你的腰 囝搝你的跤
洗衫機 洗衫機 莫走傷遠
規家伙仔 攏咧後壁逐

[Verse]
行過飯桌 挵著茶鈷
貓仔驚甲 走去冰箱頂覕
阮查某囝 規个坐起去頂懸
伊才乖乖 停佇門口

[Bridge]
原來是一肢跤 短一屑仔
阮翁提一塊柴片 塞落去

[Chorus]
洗衫機 洗衫機 這馬乖矣
三千五 閣送一場舞
洗衫機 洗衫機 好物無貴
規家伙仔 笑甲坐落塗跤

[Outro]
三千五 閣送一場舞

tracks.title: 接枝 Tsiap-ki
tracks.mood: tender, sly and patient, a husband keeping a three-year secret in a tree
tracks.subject: a husband secretly grafting Irwin (aiwen) mango scions onto the sour native mango tree his grandfather planted behind the house, because his wife buys Irwin mangoes at the market every year, and three summers later the tree fruits both kinds
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien sertanejo romântico, Brazilian country-ballad style. A ten-string viola caipira playing bright double-stop fills; steel-string acoustic guitar strumming; accordion swells between phrases; soft round electric bass; light brushed drums. Warm, clean modern sertanejo mix with the guitars upfront. A warm male lead singing tenderly, joined by a woman in close duet harmony in parallel thirds. 84 BPM, G major. Tender, sly and patient. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM synths, no Mandarin pop ballad strings, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
厝後彼欉土檨仔 阿公種的
酸甲你食一喙 目睭就瞇
你逐年攏佇市場 買愛文
一粒一粒 揀甲足斟酌

[Pre-Chorus]
今年春天 我借一支接枝刀
偷偷仔 爬上樹仔尾

[Chorus]
等一下 等一下 閣三冬
這欉樹 會生你愛的彼款
你毋免閣 佇市場揀甲遐久
厝後就有 規欉甜的

[Verse]
我共新枝 縛甲密密密
塑膠紙 包一圈閣一圈
你問我規日 佇樹頂創啥
我講咧看 鳥仔有來無

[Pre-Chorus]
寒流彼暗 我起來三擺
手電仔照一下 才閣去睏

[Chorus]
等一下 等一下 閣兩冬
新葉仔 已經紅紅吐出來
你若問我 我猶原毋講
厝後的祕密 我顧甲足牢

[Verse]
第三年 五月樹頂黃一片
你徛佇樹跤 攑頭看真久
土檨仔這爿 愛文彼爿
你笑講 這欉樹生兩款面

[Bridge]
你哪會知 我愛食這款
二十年 你逐擺攏看佇咧

[Chorus]
免閣等 免閣等 今仔日
這欉樹 生你愛的彼款
你毋免閣 佇市場揀甲遐久
我佇樹頂 共你挽上甜的

[Outro]
一粒愛文 一粒土檨

tracks.title: 國民法官六號 Kok-bîn Huat-kuann La̍k-hō
tracks.subject: an ordinary man drawn by lot as citizen judge number six (Taiwan's citizen judge system) for a six-day fraud trial, who may tell no one, tells his wife it's a business trip, eats cold pork-chop lunchboxes in silence with five strangers, and casts his vote
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien post-punk in the Irish and British 2020s revival style. A wiry clean trebly guitar riffing in tight repeated figures; a driving melodic bass carrying the hook; tight dry snare and fast closed hi-hat; a second guitar scraping chords. Dry, cold, close-miked live-room mix with the bass loud. A flat male baritone, half-spoken and dry, rising to a shouted chorus. 150 BPM, E minor. Deadpan, tense and quietly dutiful. No synth pop, no pop-punk chorus, no autotune, no trap drums, no metal growls.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
一張批寄來 紅色的印
我的名 予電腦抽著
六工 愛去法院報到
毋通講 毋通錄 毋通問

[Pre-Chorus]
我共牽手講 公司欲出差

[Chorus]
我是國民法官 六號
坐佇第二排 正手爿
我是國民法官 六號
規工 喙合牢牢

[Verse]
檢察官講 三百萬
被告講 伊毋知影
證人講 伊袂記得
我共筆記簿 寫甲滿滿

[Pre-Chorus]
中晝便當 排骨冷冷
六个人 無人敢開喙

[Chorus]
我是國民法官 六號
坐佇第二排 正手爿
我是國民法官 六號

tracks.title: 九降風的菜脯 Káu-kàng-hong ê Tshài-póo
tracks.mood: hazy, tender and windswept, a long dry winter on a rooftop
tracks.subject: a granddaughter spending one dry, windy Hsinchu winter on the rooftop with her living grandmother making sun-dried radish (菜脯): weeks of salting, turning the radish morning and night on bamboo trays in the northeast 'nine-descending' wind, while the grandmother talks about working the salt pans and the salty radish grandpa brought when he first came courting
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien shoegaze in the early-1990s British style. Layered reverb-drenched electric guitars with tremolo-arm bends and a dense sustained wash; warm fuzz bass; soft roomy drums with washy cymbals; a faint organ drone underneath. Warm, blurred wall-of-sound mix with the vocal low and soft. A breathy female vocal singing close and unhurried, half-buried in the guitars. 92 BPM, D major. Hazy, tender and windswept. No pop vocal upfront, no autotune, no trap drums, no EDM synths, no metal distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
十一月 阿嬤叫我起去頂樓
菜頭排規列 白白佇竹篩仔頂
九降風 對北爿吹過來
吹甲阮兩个 頭毛亂亂

[Pre-Chorus]
伊無講欲按怎做
干焦講 風來矣 就好

[Chorus]
九降風 九降風
吹予菜頭 慢慢軟去
阿嬤的話 一句一句
佮鹽 做伙揉入去

[Verse]
透早翻一擺 暗時翻一擺
伊講少年時 佇鹽埕做工
講阿公頭擺來 提一包菜脯
伊笑講 彼包 鹹甲食袂落

[Pre-Chorus]
日頭落山 風猶未歇
阮共竹篩仔 收入來

[Chorus]
九降風 九降風
吹予菜頭 縮甲細細
阿嬤的話 一句一句
囥佇甕仔內 慢慢鹹

[Verse]
第三禮拜 菜頭變金色
伊的手 比菜脯閣較皺
伊講 你的手 嘛會變按呢
我講 好啊 我無要緊

[Bridge]
風吹過頂樓 吹過阮兩个
伊講 毋免寫 鼻就知

[Chorus]
九降風 九降風
吹到過年 甕仔滇矣
阿嬤閣講 明年猶原
頂樓 咱兩个

[Outro]
甕仔 閣加一層

tracks.mood: rowdy, sweaty and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a Bangkok office's Friday pot-luck where Pae from purchasing brings a somtam made with thirty bird's-eye chillies; one bite each sends the whole 14th floor queueing at the water cooler, while the narrator calmly keeps eating and becomes the only person Pae will pound it for
tracks.caption: Thai baile funk rap, Brazilian funk carioca beat with Thai street rap. Rolling tamborzão drum-machine pattern, a booming distorted 808 kick, squeaking cuíca hits, short blaring brass stabs and loose handclaps on the offbeats. Dry, punchy Rio-style mix with heavy low end and a close, unprocessed vocal. Female rapper with a fast, playful Thai flow, an office crew shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, A minor. Rowdy, sweaty and laughing at itself. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no pop chorus, no reggaeton dembow.

พี่แป๋วนั่งมองฉันตักคำที่สิบ หน้าไม่มีเหงื่อสักเม็ด

tracks.subject: a man spending his first Songkran at his girlfriend's family home learning her grandmother's tong card game to win the family over, losing every hand for three days, until the grandmother deals to him first and calls him หลาน
tracks.caption: T-pop solo male dance-pop, mid-2020s performance-track style with an R&B tint. Bouncy plucked synth bass, a crisp four-on-the-floor kick with off-beat open hats, muted funk guitar scratches, a bright wide synth pad, finger snaps in the verses. Polished, tight, clean modern mix with light plate reverb. Male tenor with smooth, breathy verses and a clean falsetto lift in the chorus. 112 BPM, E minor. Shy, warm and quietly sure. tracks.lyrics:

สงกรานต์ปีแรกที่บ้านคุณ ผมใส่เสื้อลายดอกมาไหว้
ยายนั่งล้อมวงใต้ถุนบ้าน ไพ่ตองวางเต็มเสื่อ
คุณกระซิบว่าถ้าอยากให้ยายรัก ต้องนั่งลงเล่นด้วย

ตาแรกก็หมด ตาสองก็หมด

ตาสุดท้ายยายแจกให้ผมก่อน แล้วเรียกผมว่าหลาน

tracks.title: อ่านได้หมด (I Can Read Them All)
tracks.subject: a Roi Et rice farmer on his first trip abroad, a temple tour bus to Vientiane his daughter paid for, who bets the Lao driver a crate of Beerlao that he can read every Lao shop sign because it is nearly Isan, and loses to a French bakery sign and the railway station sign he reads as a discount on lights
tracks.caption: 1970s Isan lam phloen revival, the original luk thung Isan dance rhythm. Buzzing khaen drone and quick riffs, a twangy electric phin lead, bouncy Fender bass walking under it, a tight drum kit with the skipping lam phloen beat and small ching cymbals, short trumpet fills between lines. Warm early-1970s band-room recording, slightly saturated tape, mono-leaning. Male mid-range Isan singer with bright nasal lam ornaments and spoken asides. 128 BPM, D major. Cheeky, boastful and good-humoured. No modern EDM, no trap, no autotune, no rock guitar solo, no string pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - khaen drone, phin riff, ching cymbals]

[Verse 1]
ทั้งชีวิตข่อยบ่เคยข้ามโขง เทื่อนี้ลูกสาวซื้อทัวร์ให้
รถบัสวัดออกจากร้อยเอ็ด ตีห้าคนเฒ่าเต็มคัน
ข้ามขัวมิตรภาพฮอดเวียงจันทน์ ข่อยโม้ใส่คนขับลาว
ป้ายลาวบ่ยากดอกหล่า มันเกือบเป็นภาษาอีสาน

[Pre-Chorus]
คนขับยิ้มถามว่า ลุงกล้าพนันบ่
อ่านผิดป้ายเดียว ลุงเลี้ยงเบียร์ลาวหนึ่งลัง

[Chorus]
อ่านได้หมด อ่านได้หมด ป้ายเวียงจันทน์ข่อยอ่านได้หมด
ร้านเฝอ ร้านขายยา ตลาดเช้า ข่อยอ่านออกทุกคำ
อ่านได้หมด อ่านได้หมด ภาษาพี่ภาษาน้องกัน
ตัวหนังสือมนกว่าแหน่ แต่ข่อยบ่ยอมแพ้ดอก

[Verse 2]
ฮอดร้านขนมปังใกล้น้ำพุ ป้ายตัวหนังสือฝรั่งตัวใหญ่
ข่อยอ่านเสียงดัง บู-ลัง-เก-รี คนทั้งรถหัวพร้อมกัน
คนขับว่าภาษาฝรั่งเศสลุง ข่อยว่าบ่นับ บ่แม่นป้ายลาว
ไปอีกหน่อยเห็นป้าย ลดไฟ ข่อยว่าร้านนี้หลอดไฟลดราคา

[Bridge - spoken aside over khaen]
คนขับหัวจนน้ำตาไหล ลุงเอ้ย นั่นสถานีรถไฟ
ลาวเขียนรถไฟจั่งซี้ บ่มีไผบอกข่อยจักเทื่อ

[Chorus]
อ่านได้หมด อ่านได้หมด เกือบได้หมดแหละพี่น้อง
ลดไฟ บู-ลัง-เก-รี สองป้ายนั้นบ่นับเด้อ
อ่านได้หมด อ่านได้หมด เบียร์ลาวลังหนึ่งข่อยจ่ายเอง
ขากลับคนขับสอนข่อยอ่าน ตลอดทางฮอดหนองคาย

[Outro - trumpet fill, khaen riff, band stops on the beat]

tracks.title: สูบน้ำคืนเดือนสาม (Pumping Water in the Third Month)
tracks.subject: a young man running the diesel pump every dry-season night onto his family's shallot beds on the Chi river bank in Maha Sarakham, and the young woman who runs the pump on the next plot; they talk across the ditch over the engine noise until he offers to carry her pipe
tracks.caption: 1980s Isan lam phaen cassette electronics, molam phrasing over early home-keyboard backing. A cheap drum machine with a handclap preset, a rubbery Casio-style synth bass, electric phin picking the melody, khaen washed in spring reverb, thin toy-organ chords. Lo-fi 1980s cassette sound with hiss, slightly wobbly tape pitch and narrow stereo. Duet: male and female Isan singers trading lam phrases, light and conversational. 104 BPM, G minor. Shy, warm and patient. No modern trap, no autotune, no big reverb pop production, no rock drums, no orchestral strings.

tracks.title: บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า (Wild Blueberries)
tracks.mood: tired, wry and homesick but grinning
tracks.subject: a Chaiyaphum man on his third summer picking wild blueberries in the forests of Finnish Lapland, counting buckets at the scale each evening, cooking sticky rice in a borrowed school kitchen, and noticing the August sun is still up at eleven at night
tracks.caption: Thai acoustic pop-rap, mid-2020s guitar-led rap pop. A strummed nylon-string guitar loop, soft dusty boom-bap drums with a gentle swing, a round upright-style bass, sparse Rhodes chords under the hook. Warm, dry acoustic mix, close mic, light vinyl warmth. Male rapper with a relaxed, conversational Thai flow; a soft, airy female voice sings the hook. 88 BPM, C major. Tired, wry and homesick but grinning. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build, no rock guitars, no orchestral swell.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar loop, soft boom-bap drums]

[Verse 1]
ปีที่สามที่ผมบินมาแลปแลนด์ ป่าสนสูงกว่าบ้านที่ชัยภูมิ
ตีห้าครึ่งหิ้วถังสองใบ ยุงที่นี่ตัวโตไม่แพ้บ้านเรา
เก็บบลูเบอร์รี่จนนิ้วม่วง เล็บดำไปทั้งเดือนสิงหา
เย็นมาเข้าคิวที่ตาชั่ง เขาจ่ายกิโลละไม่กี่ยูโร

[Chorus - female]
บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า เต็มถังแล้วหรือยัง
สามทุ่มแดดยังไม่ยอมตก
บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า เก็บอีกนิดแล้วนอน
ตื่นมาก็ป่าเดิม

[Verse 2]
โรงเรียนร้างเขาให้เราอยู่ ครัวเด็กเล็กใช้นึ่งข้าวเหนียว
แจ่วใส่ขวดมาจากบ้าน เหลือครึ่งขวดต้องกินประหยัด
เพื่อนจากยโสเปิดหมอลำ คนฟินแลนด์เดินผ่านมายืนฟัง
เขาถามว่านี่เพลงอะไร ผมบอกเพลงคนเก็บของป่าเหมือนกัน

[Chorus - female]
บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า เต็มถังแล้วหรือยัง
สามทุ่มแดดยังไม่ยอมตก
บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า ส่งเงินแล้วค่อยนอน
กันยาก็ได้กลับบ้าน

[Outro - guitar loop alone, drums drop out]

tracks.title: Vạch Nước Sáu Giờ
tracks.subject: a man who rides onto Long Biên Bridge at six every morning to watch the woman he loves read the Red River water-level gauge staff below, learning the name of every painted mark until she says that is enough to meet her mother
tracks.caption: Vietnamese dream pop, 2020s Hanoi indie dream-pop ballad. Chorused clean electric guitar playing slow ringing arpeggios with tape echo; soft drum machine with brushed snare and a muted kick; warm sustained organ pad; round melodic bass gliding under the chords. Reverb-washed but clear mix, wide and soft, no distortion walls. Male soft breathy baritone, close-miked and unhurried. 78 BPM, D major. Hazy, tender and quietly devoted. No shoegaze distortion, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chorused clean guitar arpeggios, soft drum machine, organ pad]

[Verse 1]
Sáu giờ kém năm, anh dắt xe lên cầu Long Biên
Em đứng dưới chân cột thủy chí, áo phao cam
Mặt sông đỏ nặng phù sa chậm trôi qua
Em đọc từng vạch sơn trắng, rồi ghi số vào ô

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh chẳng biết gì về mực nước
Chỉ biết em sẽ ngẩng lên khi tàu chạy qua

[Chorus]
Hôm nay sông lên bao nhiêu hả em
Hai mét ba hay hai mét tư
Ghi xong rồi thì ngẩng lên đây
Anh mua hai cốc trà đá đầu cầu

[Verse 2]
Mùa cạn sông lùi xa tận bãi ngô
Em lội bùn xuống tới vạch cuối cùng
Tháng Tám nước dâng sát chân cầu thang
Em gọi anh đứng lùi ra, đừng lại gần

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh học thuộc tên từng vạch sơn
Em bảo thuộc thế thì về ra mắt mẹ em

[Chorus]
Hôm nay sông lên bao nhiêu hả em
Hai mét ba hay hai mét tư
Anh ghi hộ em một dòng bút chì
Người trên cầu vẫn đứng chờ ở đây

[Outro - guitar echoes, distant train rumble fading]

tracks.title: Xô Thứ Một Nghìn
tracks.genre: Vietnamese experimental folk-rap with metal percussion
tracks.subject: a hired crew of four and the family alone (husband, wife, their teenage son, the wife's brother) pouring their Hanoi house's concrete roof slab in one morning by bucket chain, the wife's mother on a plastic stool writing down whoever passes slowly, and the eight of them sitting on the still-wet roof when she finally opens the beer
tracks.caption: Vietnamese experimental folk-rap, mid-2020s underground hip-hop with traditional instruments and metal percussion. A plucked đàn nguyệt riff looping in the low register; trống cơm hand drum slaps; struck iron buckets, shovel clanks and sheet-metal hits as the backbeat; a deep, plain sub bass. Dry, close, clattering mix with found-metal percussion panned wide. Two gruff male rappers trading lines in a tight rhythmic flow, a small crew of workmen and family shouting the chorus. 96 BPM, A minor. Rowdy, sweaty and laughing. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no pop chorus singer, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - đàn nguyệt riff, iron bucket clanks, trống cơm]

[Verse 1]
Bốn giờ sáng máy trộn đã quay ầm ầm
Bốn thợ thuê với vợ chồng chủ nhà lên giàn
Chú Bảy thợ cả đầu dây, thằng Tí cuối dây
Xô bê tông chuyền qua mười sáu bàn tay
Mẹ vợ chủ nhà ngồi ghế nhựa cầm sổ
Ai chuyền chậm là bà ghi tên thật to

[Pre-Chorus]
Đừng ngước lên, đừng ngồi xuống
Mái chưa xong thì chưa được ăn

[Chorus]
Xô lên, xô lên, xô lên nào
Xô thứ một nghìn chưa thấy bia đâu
Tay ai cũng xám, áo ai cũng ướt
Đổ xong cái mái mới được ngồi lâu

[Verse 2]
Bảy giờ nắng gắt, xi măng khô trên trán
Thằng Tí rơi xô, bà ngoại nó hét vang
Ông anh vợ hô một tiếng, cả hàng lại đều chân
Cái mái phẳng lì như mặt bàn bi-a

[Bridge - metal percussion and shouts only]
Leng keng leng keng, xẻng gõ vào thành xô
Leng keng leng keng, mười giờ là đổ xong

[Chorus]
Xô lên, xô lên, xô lên nào
Xô cuối cùng rồi, bia đâu bà ơi
Bà mẹ vợ cười, mở thùng đá ra
Cả bọn ngồi luôn trên cái mái chưa khô

[Outro - bucket clanks slow down, đàn nguyệt alone]

tracks.title: Diều Đê Ngõ Chợ
tracks.subject: kids of one Hanoi alley off the Yên Phụ dike road hauling every kite they own up onto the dike on one windy dry-season afternoon, trying to keep as many in the air at once as they can, until their strings tangle with the kites from the next alley and both gangs end up on the slope unknotting them together (not a formal contest)
tracks.caption: Hanoi techno-pop, underground Hanoi club techno with a pop vocal. Pounding four-on-the-floor kick; a rolling, squelchy acid bassline; ticking closed hi-hats and a metallic clap; dark analog synth stabs on the offbeat. Tight, driving warehouse-club mix, dry vocal sitting on top. Female cool, clear mid-range vocal, half-spoken verses and a chanted chorus. 128 BPM, F minor. Brisk, giddy windy-afternoon mischief. No Vinahouse horn riffs, no trap, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no ballad piano.

tracks.title: Rồi Răng Nữa?
tracks.subject: an old woman in a Huế garden house reading aloud on the porch the letters from her late-life pen-friend, a retired teacher in Quy Nhơn she met through a newspaper column, while her husband pretends to read the paper and keeps asking 'rồi răng nữa?'
tracks.caption: Ca Huế chamber folk-pop, contemporary crossover of Huế chamber singing and acoustic pop. Đàn tranh glissandi and plucked figures; đàn nguyệt answering the vocal; a bending đàn bầu line; breathy sáo trúc between phrases; soft upright bass and brushed snare keeping a slow pulse. Intimate acoustic chamber-room sound, close and airy. Female soft mezzo with a Huế accent and light ca Huế ornaments. 72 BPM, G minor. Warm, teasing and gently amused. No EDM beat, no rap, no autotune, no power-ballad drums, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - đàn tranh glissando, sáo trúc, soft brushes]

[Verse 1]
Chiều ni có thư từ Quy Nhơn
Tui ngồi hiên, đeo kính, xé bao thư
Ông nhà tui cầm tờ báo, giả bộ đọc
Mà tờ báo cầm ngược từ đầu

[Pre-Chorus]
Bạn tui viết: cô giáo về hưu
Sáng ra biển, chiều ngồi đan áo

[Chorus]
Rồi răng nữa? Ông hỏi khẽ
Tui đọc tiếp, ông làm như không nghe
Rồi răng nữa? Ông hỏi lần thứ ba
Tui cười: ông đọc báo đi

[Verse 2]
Thư kể cháu bạn mới vô lớp một
Kể con mèo leo lên mái tôn
Tui đọc tới đó, ông bật cười
Rồi lại cúi xuống, ho một tiếng

[Pre-Chorus]
Cuối thư bạn hỏi: ông nhà khỏe không
Tui liếc qua, ông ngồi thẳng lưng

[Chorus]
Rồi răng nữa? Ông hỏi lớn
Người ta hỏi thăm ông đó, nghe chưa
Rồi răng nữa? Ông đứng dậy
Đi lấy giấy, nói: để tui viết thêm

[Outro - đàn nguyệt alone, sáo trúc fades]

tracks.title: Đếm Mạ Bằng Tiếng Tây Ban Nha
tracks.subject: a Vietnamese rice engineer on a cooperation project in Los Palacios, Cuba, who counts seedlings wrong in Spanish all afternoon beside the Cuban agronomist Yanelis, teaches her to ask 'ăn cơm chưa', and files for an extension after three harvests
tracks.caption: Vietnamese bachata-pop, modern Dominican-style bachata with Vietnamese pop vocals. Bright requinto lead guitar playing quick sixteenth-note arpeggios; strummed nylon rhythm guitar; bongos with the classic martillo pattern; scraping güira; syncopated electric bass. Bright, dry, live-band room sound. Male smooth light tenor, playful and close. 128 BPM, E minor. Sunny, flirtatious and warm. No reggaeton dembow beat, no trap, no autotune, no EDM drop, no V-pop ballad piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - requinto guitar arpeggios, bongos, güira]

[Verse 1]
Ruộng Los Palacios nắng như ruộng Thái Bình
Anh cắm cọc chia ô, em cầm bảng ghi
Anh đếm mạ tiếng Tây Ban Nha, em sửa từng câu
Uno, dos, tres, anh nói sai cả buổi chiều

[Pre-Chorus]
Em cười bảo anh nói như người say
Anh bảo tại em đứng gần quá

[Chorus]
Yanelis ơi, đếm lại cho anh
Một khóm, hai khóm, ba khóm xanh
Hết mùa này anh còn chưa về
Còn chờ em dạy tới số trăm

[Verse 2]
Tối hợp tác xã mở loa nhạc ngoài sân
Em kéo anh ra, chân anh giẫm chân em
Anh dạy em nói câu ăn cơm chưa
Tối nào em cũng hỏi, dù vừa ăn xong

[Pre-Chorus]
Ba vụ lúa rồi anh xin ở lại
Giấy gia hạn anh ký bằng hai thứ tiếng

[Chorus]
Yanelis ơi, đếm lại cho anh
Một khóm, hai khóm, ba khóm xanh
Mùa sau em về Thái Bình với anh
Anh dạy em đếm từ một tới trăm

[Outro - requinto solo, güira fades]

tracks.title: 唔該唔好掂
tracks.subject: a gallery attendant at the Hong Kong Museum of History who spends her whole shift telling visitors not to touch the red-sail fishing junk and the old tram, a schoolboy who climbs in and rings the tram bell, and her own secret tap on the junk's glass case after closing
tracks.caption: Cantonese dancehall pop, Hong Kong 2020s riddim-pop. Syncopated dancehall riddim drum machine with rimshot clicks, round warm sub bass, a bright wooden marimba riff, offbeat muted synth stabs. Dry punchy modern mix, roomy marimba, clean close vocal. Female mid-register voice, playful half-sung patter in the verses and a firm, almost spoken chorus hook. 98 BPM, F minor. Cheeky and bouncing, secretly fond. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no reggae one-drop, no rock guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早十點開門 我企喺第三展廳
制服燙到好筆直 對講機夾喺腰
有個阿叔伸手 想摸嗰隻紅帆船
我未開口佢已經笑 話佢細個坐過

[Pre-Chorus]
我深呼吸 舉起一隻手
語氣要客氣 但係一步都唔退

[Chorus]
唔該唔好掂 唔該唔好掂
玻璃後面嗰啲嘢 老過你幾百年
影相得 唔好閃燈 退後少少就啱晒
唔該唔好掂 我講咗成日都未厭

[Verse]
十二點有團細路 排住隊入嚟
老師喺後面數人頭 數極都差一個
原來佢鑽咗入去 舊電車個車廂
扯住條鐘繩 叮叮叮 成個館都聽到

[Pre-Chorus]
我行過去 蹲低同佢講
你坐得好正 不過要落返嚟先

[Chorus]
唔該唔好掂 唔該唔好掂
嗰條鐘繩好舊㗎 嗰陣你阿爺都未出世
影相得 唔好閃燈 叮完一聲就算數
唔該唔好掂 我講咗成日都未厭

[Verse]
六點鐘閂門 燈一格一格咁熄
我拎住塊布 抹走玻璃上面啲手指印
四圍冇人 我望住隻紅帆船
手指輕輕篤一篤 好似同佢講聲晚安

[Bridge]
冇人睇見 冇人會知
聽朝十點 我又企返喺度

[Chorus]
唔該唔好掂 唔該唔好掂
其實我都好想掂 企咗喺度八年
影相得 唔好閃燈 聽日再嚟搵我傾
唔該唔好掂 我講咗成日都未厭

[Outro]
唔該唔好掂
唔該 唔該 唔好掂

tracks.title: 三點四十五
tracks.subject: a married couple who both work non-teaching jobs at the same secondary school, the lab technician and the librarian, meeting every day at 3:45 after the bell to split one cold bottle of Vitasoy in the empty science prep room, six years on
tracks.caption: Cantonese melodic house, Hong Kong melodic house and techno-pop crossover. Rolling arpeggiated analog synth line, soft round four-on-the-floor kick, warm Rhodes electric piano chords, a deep gliding bassline and an airy pad. Spacious club mix with long pad reverb and a dry close vocal. Male tenor, soft and intimate, a gentle lift into the chorus. 120 BPM, A minor. Warm, steady and quietly in love. No big-room drop, no trap, no autotune, no rap, no festival build-ups.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
三點四十五 放學鐘一響
我洗乾淨啲試管 排返喺架上
走廊啲學生 衝晒落操場
我返去實驗準備室 等你落嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
你推開門 手指仲有啲膠水
坐落張高櫈 你就笑一笑

[Chorus]
三點四十五 學校靜返晒
你推門入嚟 我喺窗邊等
一支凍維他奶 一人飲一半
六年都係咁 我仲係會心跳

[Verse]
你話今日有個中二仔
借咗本恐龍書 問你有冇續集
我話實驗室 又爆咗個燒杯
你笑我日日 都有嘢報告

[Pre-Chorus]
窗外有人 打緊籃球
你幫佢數住 入咗幾多個波

[Chorus]
三點四十五 學校靜返晒
你推門入嚟 我喺窗邊等
一支凍維他奶 你飲多咗啲
我扮唔知 等你笑多陣

[Verse]
有日你問我 如果嗰年
我冇揀呢間學校 會唔會識到你
我話我都唔知 但係我知
今日三點四十五 你喺度

[Bridge]
啲燈一盞一盞熄
看更阿伯叫我哋走啦

[Chorus]
三點四十五 學校靜返晒
我鎖好藥品櫃 你幫我熄燈
一支凍維他奶 飲剩個樽
放喺窗台度 聽日再嚟換

[Outro]
三點四十五
聽日三點四十五

tracks.title: 七點半校門口
tracks.subject: a young woman whose older sister paid her HK$8,000 school fees and would not take an IOU; with no money to repay, she walks her six-year-old niece to school at 7:30 every weekday for a year, ticking each trip on a fridge calendar, and when she finally brings the HK$8,000 the sister pushes it back and says the school runs aren't finished
tracks.caption: Cantonese bedroom pop, Hong Kong lo-fi indie pop. Clean chorus-washed electric guitar picking, a soft boxy drum machine, round mellow synth bass, felt-muted toy piano notes. Lo-fi home-recorded feel with light tape hiss, narrow warm mix. Female breathy close-mic vocal, low and unhurried, some lines half-whispered. 78 BPM, D major. Shy, stubborn and tender. No trap beat, no autotune, no big chorus harmonies, no orchestral strings, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
舊年夏天 家姐幫我交咗學費
八千蚊 佢話唔使還
我冇錢還 又唔想就咁算
我話每朝 等我送囡囡返學

[Pre-Chorus]
七點正 我喺佢樓下等
囡囡揹住個書包 大過佢成個人

[Chorus]
七點半 校門口
我拖住佢 佢拖住我
一朝一程 我心入面數住
仲爭幾多程 先還得清家姐

[Verse]
佢一路行 一路講佢班同學
邊個喊咗 邊個唔記得帶功課
佢鞋帶甩咗 我踎低幫佢綁
佢話姨姨 你行得慢過婆婆

[Pre-Chorus]
我喺雪櫃門 貼咗張日曆紙
送完一朝 就喺上面剔一剔

[Chorus]
七點半 校門口
佢入咗閘 先至轉身同我揮手
一格一格 剔到第三版
都仲未夠還 我欠家姐嗰八千

[Verse]
放暑假嗰朝 我照樣七點到
佢著住睡衣開門 話今日唔使返學喎
我坐喺佢屋企 唔知做乜好
家姐沖咗杯奶茶 擺喺嘉頓餅罐隔籬

[Bridge]
我打開個罐 入面係我硬塞畀佢嗰張借條
佢一直收埋 夾喺囡囡啲手工度

[Chorus]
七點半 校門口
九月又到 我攞住八千去搵佢
佢推返落我手 話你仲未送完
囡囡升小二 你聽朝照舊七點

[Outro]
七點半
我個鬧鐘 冇再改過

tracks.title: 邊個又郁咗
tracks.subject: a man who spends a Sunday putting the family's living-room TV channels in a sensible order, then wages a running war with his mum, little sister, grandpa and dad, who keep scrambling it, until a family vote puts the Korean drama channel first
tracks.caption: Cantonese oompah polka, Bavarian beer-hall brass polka sung in Cantonese. Oom-pah tuba on the downbeat, a piano accordion riff on the off-beat, fast clarinet runs, trumpet and tenor horn stabs, snare and bass drum on a strict two-step. Brass-band beer-hall mix, tuba and accordion up front, handclaps and table thumps. Male baritone with a deadpan comic delivery, a small group shouting the hook back. 118 BPM, F major. Exasperated, comic and stomping. No Latin percussion, no reggaeton, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
我花咗成個禮拜日 執好部電視
翡翠排第一 明珠排第二
新聞台跟住 財經台排最尾
遙控一撳 一二三 順到好似排隊

[Pre-Chorus]
點知禮拜一 我放工返屋企
一撳個一字 出咗個卡通台

[Chorus]
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
一二三四 全部亂晒籠
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
成家人企喺度 個個話唔關我事

[Verse]
阿媽話佢淨係 想睇套韓劇
細妹話佢淨係 搵返個卡通台
阿爺話佢冇掂過 係部機自己跳
阿爸成晚扮瞓 遙控喺佢枕頭底

[Pre-Chorus]
我寫好張紙 列晒個次序
貼喺電視隔籬 仲過咗膠

[Chorus]
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
張紙貼咗喺度 都冇人理
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
第二朝起身 新聞台走咗去第九

[Verse]
我收埋個遙控 喺我個衣櫃度
用條毛巾包住 鎖咗兩重鎖
點知琴晚 我見到阿媽
企喺電視前面 逐個掣咁撳

[Bridge]
原來部電視 自己都有掣
我用咗咁多年 都唔知

[Chorus]
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
今次我話 大家投票決定
邊個又郁咗 邊個又郁咗
投完票 韓劇台排咗第一

[Outro]
邊個又郁咗
算啦 我學識咗撳第九

tracks.title: 數錯湯圓
tracks.subject: an old man in Tsuen Wan who, every winter solstice eve, hand-rolls black-sesame tong yuen, two each, for his three grown children's households and grandkids coming for dinner, keeps miscounting, ends up three over, then needs four more when his son brings his girlfriend's mother and his son-in-law wants four, and gives his own bowl to his grandson
tracks.caption: Cantonese bluegrass, acoustic string-band bluegrass sung in Cantonese. Rolling three-finger five-string banjo, a sawing fiddle, flatpicked acoustic guitar runs, slapped upright bass, mandolin chop on the backbeat. Dry acoustic string-band room sound, close mics, no drums. Male weathered mid-range voice with plain storytelling delivery and a gang-vocal chorus. 128 BPM, G major. Fussy, folksy and laughing. No drum kit, no country-pop gloss, no trap, no autotune, no electric guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
冬至前一晚 我喺荃灣屋企
一包糯米粉 一碗黑芝麻
大仔一家四個 二女一家三
細仔帶埋女朋友 再加我同老婆

[Pre-Chorus]
搓好一粒 擺落個盤
口度數住 一 二 三

[Chorus]
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
一人兩粒 點解又唔夠數
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
阿爺我 再搓多兩粒

[Verse]
孫女坐喺我隔籬 話幫阿爺數
數到十七 就攞咗一粒去搓公仔
我又試咗一粒 驚啲餡唔夠甜
試完先記得 嗰粒係二女嘅

[Pre-Chorus]
重新排過 一家一行
大仔行頭 細仔排最尾

[Chorus]
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
十一個人 點解有廿五粒
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
多出嗰三粒 唔知係邊個嘅

[Verse]
冬至夜晚 成屋都係人
細仔入門 話女朋友帶埋佢阿媽
二女個老公 又話要食四粒
老婆喺廚房 笑住叫我再開粉

[Bridge]
多出三粒 都仲爭一粒
我自己嗰碗 就讓返畀個孫

[Chorus]
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
今晚個個 都話食得好飽
數錯湯圓 數錯湯圓
聽年冬至 我再數過

[Outro]
數錯湯圓
一 二 三 四 數到天光

tracks.title: 臭花倒數
tracks.subject: Taipei botanical garden staff and a growing crowd waiting four nights for a giant corpse flower (titan arum) to open, everyone holding their noses and refusing to go home
tracks.caption: Chinese folk-melody phonk, Douyin drift-phonk style built on a pentatonic folk tune. Ringing distorted cowbell playing the folk melody, a buzzing hulusi riff answering it, heavily saturated 808 bass slides, fast Memphis-style hi-hats and rimshots, crisp handclaps. Clipped, saturated low end with a dry upfront vocal. Bright female lead with a folk-singer timbre, half-chanted, a crew of friends shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, A minor. Giddy, mock-heroic and silly. No trap rap verses, no autotune, no EDM supersaw drop, no ballad piano, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - cowbell folk melody, hulusi answers, 808 slides in]

[Verse 1]
溫室門口排到第三根路燈
園丁阿伯說今晚應該會開
它憋了七年只為開兩天
我們捏著鼻子還在等

[Pre-Chorus]
數到三 先別走
風一吹 誰先吐

[Chorus]
臭花倒數 臭花倒數
三 二 一 它還是沒動
口罩戴兩層 也擋不住
臭到整條南海路

[Verse 2]
第四晚帶了板凳和鹹酥雞
隔壁小孩把爸爸當枕頭
凌晨兩點葉片抖了一下
全場安靜像在等放榜

[Pre-Chorus]
數到三 別眨眼
味道 比花先到

[Chorus]
臭花倒數 臭花倒數
三 二 一 它真的打開
死老鼠加上臭襪子
我們一邊叫一邊拍

[Outro - cowbell and claps, crew shouts, 808 cuts out]
下一次 再等七年
我還來

tracks.title: 原封不動
tracks.mood: giddy, sly, in on the joke
tracks.subject: an office secret-santa exchange on the last Friday before Christmas where, gift by gift, it emerges that everyone has quietly regifted last year's present, still in its wrapping
tracks.caption: Mandarin French touch filter house, late-90s Parisian filter disco revived in the Justice Hyperdrama era. A looped disco string-and-horn chord sample under a sweeping low-pass filter, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, a rubbery slap-style electric bass line, phaser-swept synth stabs, off-beat hand claps. Glossy, sidechain-pumping club mix where the filter opens fully on each chorus. Smooth female alto, conversational and dry, trading lines with a small office group chorus. 124 BPM, F minor. Giddy, sly and in on the joke. No hand drums or congas, no marimba, no log drums, no big-room EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - filtered disco chord loop, kick and claps, filter slowly opens]

[Verse 1]
十二月最後一個星期五
會議室的燈 關了一半
我抽到七號 拿到一盒
包裝紙上 還貼著去年的名牌

[Pre-Chorus]
這個香氛蠟燭 怎麼好眼熟
去年我送出去的 就是它

[Chorus - filter fully open, slap bass]
原封不動 原封不動
繞了一圈 又回到我手中
大家笑著說謝謝 誰也不說破
原封不動 聖誕快樂

[Verse 2]
會計拆到圍巾 吊牌還在
經理拿到保溫杯 是他去年買的
實習生舉起卡片 念出聲來
給小陳 聖誕快樂 去年寫的

[Pre-Chorus]
小陳低下頭 喝了一口水
整個會議室 突然好安靜

[Chorus - filter fully open, slap bass]
原封不動 原封不動
繞了一圈 又回到原來那裡
大家笑著說謝謝 誰也不說破
原封不動 明年再見

[Outro - filter closes on the disco loop, kick and claps, group chants]
明年再見 明年再見

tracks.title: 雙人車 一個人騎
tracks.subject: a woman at a riverside bike-rental shop counter ending the annual tandem-bicycle rental her ex signed them both up for, while the owner keeps asking where the other rider is; she takes the tandem out alone for one last lap along the river before handing it back
tracks.caption: Mandarin indie-sleaze dance-rock, 2000s loft-party dance-rock as revived in 2025. A choppy, dry-toned electric guitar riff in sixteenths, a disco hi-hat drum kit with cowbell on the off-beats, a driving octave-jumping bass line, a cheap analog synth arpeggio, handclaps. Loose, bright, slightly overdriven mix with short room reverb. Female lead, half-sung half-spoken and deadpan, belting the hook with small group shouts. 128 BPM, A minor. Furious, funny and cathartic. No punk shouting, no blast-beat drums, no trap beat, no autotune, no ballad breakdown, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - choppy guitar riff and cowbell, bass joins]

[Verse 1]
河濱租車店 老闆在打瞌睡
我把租約拍在櫃台上
那台雙人車 綠色的 前面那個座位
是他簽的 一年一約

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆抬頭問 另一個人呢
我說 你別問了

[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的踏板 自己在轉
你問他呢 他早就下車
我今天 來退這台

[Verse 2]
老闆又問 要不要換單人的
他說雙人的 一個人很難騎
我說去年也是我在踩
他坐後面 只負責拍照

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆又問 那他還來嗎
我說 你再問一次試試

[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的座位 載著風
你問他呢 他在別人後座
我最後 再騎一圈

[Bridge - guitar drops out, bass and cowbell]
沿著河 騎過那座橋
龍頭有點歪 我也不管
押金退給我 本人在這
一千二 一毛都別少

[Outro - riff returns, then cuts dead]
停好車 鑰匙還你
我走路回家 快多了

[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的踏板 自己在轉
你問他呢 他早就下車
我今天 來退這台
[Verse 2]
老闆又問 要不要換單人的
他說雙人的 一個人很難騎
我說去年也是我在踩
他坐後面 只負責拍照
[Pre-Chorus]
老闆又問 那他還來嗎
我說 你再問一次試試
[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的座位 載著風
你問他呢 他在別人後座
我最後 再騎一圈
[Bridge - guitar drops out, bass and cowbell]
沿著河 騎過那座橋
龍頭有點歪 我也不管
押金退給我 本人在這
一千二 一毛都別少
[Outro - riff returns, then cuts dead]
停好車 鑰匙還你
我走路回家 快多了

tracks.title: 四個月見一次針頭
tracks.subject: a couple who first met in the next beds at a blood donation centre and have gone back together every four months for six years, he still scared of the needle and holding her hand, she squeezing the rubber ball for him
tracks.caption: Mandarin chamber jazz-pop, Laufey-style vintage vocal jazz with classical strings. Gently strummed nylon-string guitar with jazz chords, walking upright bass, soft brushed snare, a warm string quartet answering the melody, sparkling celesta accents. Close, warm vintage room sound with soft strings behind the voice. Warm low female alto, intimate, a slight 1950s croon. 84 BPM, Bb major. Tender, wry and quietly devoted. No pop drums, no autotune, no synths, no R&B runs, no big-band brass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and celesta, strings enter]

[Verse 1]
六年前你躺在我隔壁床
臉比護士的口罩還白
你說可以借我的手嗎
我把擠壓球塞給你

[Pre-Chorus]
針還沒進去 你先閉眼

[Chorus]
四個月見一次針頭
四個月牽一次你的手
二百五十西西 換一杯熱可可
你說這樣算約會嗎

[Verse 2]
後來我們一起填同一張表
你還是問 會不會很痛
護士阿姨早就認得我們
多給你一包蘇打餅

[Pre-Chorus]
針進去了 你還沒張眼

[Chorus]
四個月見一次針頭
六年了 還是牽我的手
二百五十西西 換一杯熱可可
這樣當然算約會啊

[Bridge - strings and upright bass]
下次捐血日 我已經圈在月曆上
你說那天要穿 短袖的襯衫

[Outro - celesta and nylon guitar, fading]
握緊一點 放鬆
我在這
